name: Douraku Yuusha
source:
The strategy that the hero comes up with is to increase the number of hero to fight back the army of demons. Make the girls pregnant by Mahobote, a magic of conception!!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE021860.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
为了反击魔王军，勇者想出的策略是增加勇者的人数。使用受孕魔法“魔孕术”，让女孩们怀孕吧！

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE021860.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
